pr_title: Fix image overflow in wiki overlay
pr_body:
Closes #13418 

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/4547
- [x] Depends on framework bump

We can't use `FillMode.Fit` in image itself for some reason:

- https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/issues/3365
  So, the parent height with `AutoSizeAxes.Y` will not work with image with `RelativeSizeAxes.Both`.

- The small image will become full width when using `FillMode.Fit`.

issue_context.title: Wiki overlay images overflow at higher UI scale
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug:** 
an image on the Game client > osu! program files page doesn't scale correctly at higher ui scale and overflows.

**Screenshots or videos showing encountered issue:** 
UI Scale: 1.30x
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/43358824/121408548-d0ad6500-c960-11eb-9dcf-4b50f0e61cec.png)

**osu!lazer version:** 
commit aed490803fd6d9da10db184bc14c1fd382588266
comments: Looks like need access to the sprite itself after some initial investigation, or maybe there's another way(?)

A first step would be to make the content at least mask inside the content are, so it's not overlapping other elements.

UI scaling will (quite correctly) apply to anything not using relative scale. I'm not sure how often wiki images are featured on the same line as other images or content, but the expected result here would be that increasing UI scale would increase the image's size until it fills the full width of the content container, at which point it stops getting larger.

A potential direction/solution may be to nest them inside a relative X container and set a fill mode. Not sure how well this will work but it's somewhere to start looking for a potential solution.

> A potential direction/solution may be to nest them inside a relative X container and set a fill mode. Not sure how well this will work but it's somewhere to start looking for a potential solution.

Fortunately, for now image block (like in the OP) and inline image is already in separate container. The image block itself is inside `WikiMarkdownImageBlock` with relative X. So this could be a potential solution.

I'll look into it again.

review_comments: Is there a reason for not doing this in the o!f base implementation? I'm not sure that images overflowing the bounds of the container are ever going to be useful.

Because there's two type of image.
- Inline image, it should be `AutoSizeAxes.Both` (current implementation of `MarkdownImage` in o!f).
- Block image, it should be `AutoSizeAxes.Y` and `RelativeSizeAxes.X`.

So, I only handle overflow image in osu-side because it has separate implementation for inline image and block image.

But why couldn't the handling of everything be moved to o!f?

That is, I suggest moving this to o!f and exposing a `MarkdownContainer.CreateImageBlock()` virtual method:
https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/5edaf8235d5a4d300676ec52ed17edd02747f9b7/osu.Game/Overlays/Wiki/Markdown/WikiMarkdownContainer.cs#L34-L43

I think most/all implementations of markdown are going to require the same scaling logic?

Yeah, that would do.

I just don't wanna change the implementation in o!f-side when code this.
Hmm okay, well it can be moved at any point then.
